english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a public controversy or issue over which people hold opposing views.
Use this when the issue specifically concerns a point of disagreement or dispute.

examples.english: This issue has sparked a major controversy.
examples.traditional: 呢單嘢引起咗好大爭議。

examples.english: Whether to raise the price is still an issue of dispute.
